primitive: An authoritative attempt-to-resource conflict-domain binding with an actually enforced writer admission/quarantine boundary

observed_facts.fact: scope/repo_root validated as bounded text, not resource identities or permissions
Transactional registration deduplicates task/packet only; no conflicting-resource admission predicate
Native adapter creates a worker packet using free-form scope and parent cwd, then marks it WORKING before host execution
Task semaphore is concurrency capacity, not resource-scope exclusivity
Isolation marker protects sandbox reclamation using process liveness; it is not conflicting-writer admission
Repository lock serializes in-process Git operations, is not reentrant, and is not a persistent task scope lease
Owner wait discovers obligations through evictable rows; real writer probe demonstrates a false settlement result after eviction

decision: Treat introduction of the first enforced resource-arbitration policy as exceeding the reuse-existing-owner/interface boundary. Do not silently reinterpret free-form scope as authorization or serialize every task sharing cwd.
decision_classification: Engineering scope judgment based on observed missing semantics; not a claim that implementation is impossible.
minimal_extension_proposal: Define the participating managed writers and canonical conflict domain, including read-only and isolated-task treatment. This policy is not currently encoded by worker packet scope.
Implement an atomic attempt-bound admission/quarantine check in the existing task/worker owner and records; no new database, daemon or scheduler is proposed.
Bind scoped release to retained actual cleanup obligations. Preserve cleanup errors independently of outcome and keep unknown authority quarantined.
Then add the supported bounded observer/acknowledgment path and finish the supplied acceptance matrix.
within_scope_but_not_implemented: Retaining actual owner obligations beyond visible row eviction
Separating deferred cleanup failure from promise fulfillment
Durable idempotent Brain observations and reaper uncertainty
why_not_partial_runtime_patch: The requested contract couples observation to safe scope reuse. Stopping before a partial runtime cutover avoids creating a receipt surface that has no production authority consumer/enforcer.
not_claimed: A requirement satisfied merely by a diagnostic script exiting zero
